Identified as this saint because: Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), May volume, plate for the 23rd, captioned «Михаил исповедник» and filed by Commons under Category:Michael of Synnada. 23 May is Michael the Confessor, bishop of Synada, which is the folder's bishop and confessor - not the archangel, nor Michael of Klops, nor the Michael kept with Theodore of Murom, each of which has its own plate in the series.
